how_en: Pick your sleep time now and keep it. Dim lights and screens in the last hour, make your quarters dark and quiet, and keep the same window tomorrow.
why_en: On the ISS, nights under 6 hours went with slower reactions, more stress and higher workload.
confidence_en: moderate for the problem; low to moderate for the action

how_en: Record or write a short message for someone at home. It goes with the next data window; their answer arrives later.
why_en: Contact with family is part of NASA's psychological support for crews.

how_en: Do today's planned exercise, or the part you can, and rate your mood before and after.
why_en: Exercise reduced depression symptoms across many trials, especially walking or running, yoga and strength work.

how_en: Follow the orbit: breathe in for 4 seconds as it grows and out for 6 as it shrinks, about 6 breaths a minute, for 3 or 5 minutes.
why_en: Slow breathing lowers arousal. Studies of guided breathing found less self-reported stress.

sources.cite: Mayo Clinic, Tachycardia: diagnosis and treatment

how_en: No caffeine in the 6 hours before your sleep window. ORBIT shows the cut-off time for today.
why_en: In a study, a strong dose of caffeine 6 hours before bed still cut more than an hour of sleep, and people did not notice.

how_en: A 10-minute relaxation before sleep: slow breathing, then relaxing each muscle group from feet to head.
why_en: Relaxation training is one of the recommended ways to improve sleep.

how_en: If your schedule allows, take a planned rest of up to 40 minutes. Give yourself 15 to 20 minutes to fully wake up before any critical task.
why_en: In a NASA study, pilots given a 40-minute rest slept about 26 minutes and were more alert and performed better afterwards.

sources.cite: Rosekind et al., 1994 (NASA TM, planned cockpit rest)
Rosekind et al., naps as an alertness management strategy (NASA)

how_en: Stop for 5 minutes: move, stretch, look out the window or at Earth Window.
why_en: Short breaks during work increase energy and reduce fatigue.

title_en: Your sleeping bag is for sleep
how_en: Go to your sleeping bag only when sleepy. If you cannot fall asleep after about 20 minutes, get out, do something quiet in dim light, and come back when sleepy.
why_en: This is stimulus control, a recommended part of behavioral treatment for insomnia.

how_en: Listen to music you choose for 10 minutes. Calm music if you want to slow down.
why_en: Music interventions reduced both physical and felt stress in many studies.

how_en: A guided 5-minute attention exercise: notice your breath, sounds and body without judging them.
why_en: Meditation programs showed moderate benefits for anxiety and depression.
confidence_en: low to moderate (for the short version)

title_en: Plan one thing that matters to you
how_en: Choose one small activity you value or enjoy for today, pick a time, and ORBIT will ask later how it went.
why_en: Scheduling meaningful activities is behavioral activation, an effective approach for low mood.

how_en: Today's full-disk image of Earth from NASA's DSCOVR/EPIC camera, with the time at home.
why_en: Astronauts describe seeing Earth as one of the most meaningful parts of spaceflight.

how_en: Continue the shared Constellations board your family started; each side plays a turn when the message arrives.
why_en: A game that works with the delay keeps a light, regular link with home.

how_en: Solve a board with a crewmate, taking turns on the same device. No scores against each other.
why_en: Playing cooperatively increased trust and cooperation in lab studies.

how_en: A short guide: what happened, what you need, one request. Use it before talking with a crewmate, or keep it private.
why_en: A self-guided conflict module was tested in a Mars analog mission.

sources.cite: Anderson et al., 2016 (Virtual Space Station at HI-SEAS)

how_en: Write a few lines about your day. Only you can see it.
why_en: ISS astronauts' journals show that writing helped them keep perspective.

how_en: If you are awake and able to swallow: take 15 g of fast sugar, wait 15 minutes, check again, and repeat if still under 70. Follow your onboard medical protocol.
why_en: This is the standard first step for a low reading.

sources.cite: ADA, Hypoglycemia in diabetes (15-15 rule infographic)

how_en: Drink fluids, rest, log any symptoms, and measure again in a few hours. Ask your medical officer before changing today's exercise.
why_en: In space your core temperature runs higher and rises faster during exercise than on Earth.
confidence_en: moderate for the finding; low for the action

how_en: Find a slot for the rest of today's session. Your progress bar fills with every block you complete.
why_en: Exercise protects bone, muscle and heart in space, and it also helps your mood.

sources.cite: Mazeas et al., 2022 (gamification and physical activity)
Ryan, Rigby y Przybylski, 2006 (SDT and games)
